one_sentence_story: Even when you fall right asleep after afternoon coffee, caffeine keeps your unconscious sleeping brain humming in a wired, daytime-like state.
so_what_for_you: Falling asleep fast is not the same as deep recovery. Finish your last caffeinated coffee roughly nine hours before bedtime so slow restorative waves can run full strength.

jargon_map.plain: A poised, rapid-fire brain state built for daytime thinking rather than deep sleep.
jargon_map.analogy: Leaving a car engine idling at high RPM inside a closed garage all night.

jargon_map.plain: Docking ports that track how long you have been awake to trigger deep sleep waves.
jargon_map.analogy: Parking spaces blocked by traffic cones so tired cars cannot pull in.

jargon_map.plain: Synchronized deep-sleep waves that repair and refresh your brain overnight.
jargon_map.analogy: A slow, steady night-shift cleaning crew sweeping every hallway in unison.
